messages.subject: Great warning message!
parts:
Just had to write. People (incuding me) gripe about error messages that are inscrutable, but this one way really helpful. I am fabricating data with 14 observed variables, so there is a lot of syntax. When I ran the simulateData() function, I got this message:

"
Error in lavParseModelString(model.syntax = model, warn = warn, debug = FALSE) : 
  lavaan ERROR: right-hand side of formula contains an intercept, but operator is "=~" in: f2=~0.8*y4+0.9+y5
"

Quoting the line of syntax was awesome, as I quickly saw my error (a + where an * should be).

Thanks again for the awesome tool.
